         CAST(strftime('%Y', ms.mth) AS INTEGER) AS yr

),
c AS (
  SELECT product_id, step, yr, qty,

        + AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING)) / 2.0 AS cma

),

)

ORDER BY r.product_id

WITH RECURSIVE base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words AS w
  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
),
chars(w, i, ch) AS (
  SELECT w, 1, substr(w, 1, 1) FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w, i + 1, substr(w, i + 1, 1) FROM chars WHERE i < LENGTH(w)
),
sig AS (
  SELECT w, group_concat(ch, '') AS s
  FROM (SELECT w, ch FROM chars ORDER BY w, ch)
  GROUP BY w
),
grp AS (
  SELECT s, COUNT(*) AS c FROM sig GROUP BY s HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT sig.w AS word, grp.c - 1 AS anagram_count
FROM sig
JOIN grp ON grp.s = sig.s
WHERE substr(sig.w, 1, 1) = 'r'
ORDER BY sig.w
LIMIT 10
rationale: word_list is the only table needed: words of length 4-5 are split into characters with a recursive CTE, the characters are re-concatenated in alphabetical order to form a case-sensitive anagram signature, and signatures shared by more than one distinct word identify anagram groups. Filtering signatures to words beginning with a lowercase 'r' (substr, not LIKE, to stay case-sensitive), ordering alphabetically and limiting to 10 gives the first ten words, with anagram_count = group size minus the word itself.

         m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
         CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3

              ELSE 0 END AS points
  FROM Match m
  UNION ALL

              WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1

  FROM Match m
),
standings AS (
  SELECT g.season, g.league_id, g.country_id, g.team_api_id,
         SUM(g.points) AS total_points,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.season, g.league_id, g.country_id
                            ORDER BY SUM(g.points) DESC, g.team_api_id) AS rk
  FROM games g
  GROUP BY g.season, g.league_id, g.country_id, g.team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name AS team_name,
       l.name AS league,
       c.name AS country,
       s.season AS season,

FROM standings s
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = s.team_api_id
JOIN League l ON l.id = s.league_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = s.country_id
WHERE s.rk = 1
ORDER BY c.name, l.name, s.season

WITH item_base AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id,
         oi.seller_id,
         oi.price,
         julianday(oi.shipping_limit_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS packing_days,
         COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_en
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
),
seller_agg AS (
  SELECT seller_id,
         COUNT(*) AS quantity_sold,
         SUM(price) AS total_sales,
         AVG(price) AS avg_item_price,
         AVG(packing_days) AS avg_packing_days
  FROM item_base
  GROUP BY seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_order AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT seller_id, order_id FROM item_base
),
review_agg AS (
  SELECT so.seller_id,
         AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score,
         COUNT(*) AS review_count
  FROM order_reviews r
  JOIN seller_order so ON so.order_id = r.order_id
  GROUP BY so.seller_id
),
cat_agg AS (
  SELECT seller_id,
         category_en,
         SUM(price) AS category_sales,
         COUNT(*) AS category_qty,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY SUM(price) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM item_base
  GROUP BY seller_id, category_en
)
SELECT sa.seller_id,
       s.seller_city,
       s.seller_state,
       sa.quantity_sold,
       ROUND(sa.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(sa.avg_item_price, 2) AS avg_item_price,
       ROUND(ra.avg_review_score, 2) AS avg_review_score,
       ra.review_count,
       ROUND(sa.avg_packing_days, 2) AS avg_packing_days,
       ca.category_en AS top_category_english,
       ROUND(ca.category_sales, 2) AS top_category_sales,
       ca.category_qty AS top_category_qty
FROM seller_agg sa
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = sa.seller_id
LEFT JOIN review_agg ra ON ra.seller_id = sa.seller_id
